ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub EDRKillShifter / TDSSKiller BYOVD — driver drop chained to EDR-process termination
ucs.description: Hunts RansomHub's signature pre-encryption step: dropping a vulnerable signed driver (most often via the EDRKillShifter loader, or the abused legitimate Kaspersky TDSSKiller binary with `-dcsvc` against WinDefend/Sense/CSAgent/SentinelAgent) and using it to kill EDR/AV from the kernel. Closely tied to RansomHub affiliates ex-ALPHV/BlackCat tradecraft and documented in CISA AA24-242A and Sophos X-Ops reporting (Aug 2024).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as killer_time FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE (Processes.process_name IN ("EDRKillShifter.exe","TDSSKiller.exe") OR Processes.original_file_name="EDRKillShifter*" OR match(Processes.process, "(?i)-p\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}") OR (Processes.process_name="TDSSKiller.exe" AND match(Processes.process,"(?i)-dcsvc.*(WinDefend|Sense|CSAgent|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|MsMpEng)"))) BY host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join host [| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as driver_write_time FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem WHERE Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Public\\*") BY host Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename file_name AS driver_name file_path AS driver_path file_hash AS driver_hash] | where abs(driver_write_time - killer_time) < 600 | eval delta_sec = abs(driver_write_time - killer_time) | table _time host dest user process_name process parent_process_name driver_name driver_path driver_hash delta_sec | sort - _time
ucs.kql:
let Window = 7d;
let SuspiciousDrivers = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Window)
    | where ActionType == "FileCreated"
    | where FileName endswith ".sys"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\")
    | project DriverWriteTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverPath = FolderPath, DriverFile = FileName, DriverHash = SHA256;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Window)
| where (FileName has_any ("EDRKillShifter.exe","TDSSKiller.exe")
     or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName has_any ("EDRKillShifter","TDSSKiller")
     or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-p\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"
     or (FileName =~ "TDSSKiller.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-dcsvc.*(WinDefend|Sense|CSAgent|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|MsMpEng)"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner SuspiciousDrivers on DeviceId
| where DriverWriteTime between (Timestamp - 5m .. Timestamp + 5m)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          KillerImage = FolderPath, KillerHash = SHA256,
          KillerCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          DriverFile, DriverPath, DriverHash,
          DeltaSec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, DriverWriteTime)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 7d;
let SuspiciousDrivers = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName endswith ".sys"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Public\", @"\Windows\Temp\")
    | project DriverWriteTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              DriverPath = TargetFilePath, DriverFile = TargetFileName, DriverHash = TargetFileSHA256;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
| where (TargetProcessName has_any ("EDRKillShifter.exe","TDSSKiller.exe")
     or ActingProcessFileOriginalName has_any ("EDRKillShifter","TDSSKiller")
     or TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-p\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}"
     or (TargetProcessName has "TDSSKiller.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)-dcsvc.*(WinDefend|Sense|CSAgent|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|MsMpEng)"))
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner SuspiciousDrivers on $left.DvcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where DriverWriteTime between (TimeGenerated - 5m .. TimeGenerated + 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          KillerImage = TargetProcessName, KillerCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
          DriverFile, DriverPath, DriverHash,
          DeltaSec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, DriverWriteTime)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: RansomHub EDRKillShifter / TDSSKiller BYOVD execution
id: 8b7d4f1a-c3e2-4a9b-9c1d-7e9f2b8a6c11
status: experimental
description: Detects RansomHub affiliates running the EDRKillShifter loader or abusing the legitimate Kaspersky TDSSKiller binary with -dcsvc against EDR/AV services.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-242a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/14/edr-killer-tool-edrkillshifter/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_killer:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\EDRKillShifter.exe'
      - '\TDSSKiller.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|re|i: '(-p\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}|-dcsvc.*(WinDefend|Sense|CSAgent|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|MsMpEng))'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (selection_killer or selection_cmd) and not filter_machine
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT staff manually invoking TDSSKiller (rare; never with -dcsvc against EDR services)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1068
  - detection.emerging_threats
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\EDRKillShifter.exe OR *\\edrkillshifter.exe OR *\\EDRKILLSHIFTER.EXE OR *\\TDSSKiller.exe OR *\\tdsskiller.exe OR *\\TDSSKILLER.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*"-dcsvc"* OR *"WinDefend"* OR *"CSFalconService"* OR *"SentinelAgent"*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(edrkillshifter|tdsskiller)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/-p\s+[A-Fa-f0-9]{32,}/i OR CommandLine=/-dcsvc.*(WinDefend|Sense|CSAgent|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|MsMpEng)/i
| join(query={#event_simpleName=FileWritten TargetFileName=/\.sys$/i TargetFileName=/\\(Users|ProgramData|Temp|Public)\\/i | rename(field=TargetFileName, as=DriverPath)}, field=aid, include=[DriverPath, ContextImageFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, DriverPath], function=count())
ucs.rationale: EDRKillShifter is a RansomHub-proprietary tool first seen in May 2024 (Sophos), and its `-p <hash>` password-key argument plus an adjacent vulnerable-driver drop is a near-unique fingerprint. The TDSSKiller `-dcsvc` abuse against EDR services is also documented as a RansomHub affiliate playbook in CISA AA24-242A. Pairing driver write with the killer-process command line in a 5-minute window collap

ucs.title: [LLM] RansomHub pre-encryption sabotage chain — Rclone-to-MEGA exfil followed by recovery destruction within 24h
ucs.description: Catches RansomHub's characteristic 'double-extortion shotgun': bulk staging via Rclone to MEGA/cloud storage, then within hours tearing down VSS/WinRE/backups (vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit/wmic) right before the encryptor fires. This exact chain is called out as RansomHub TTP in CISA AA24-242A and Mandiant M-Trends 2025.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as rclone_time FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR match(Processes.process,"(?i)rclone")) AND match(Processes.process,"(?i)(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|userstorage|--config|copy\s|sync\s|moveto\s|--transfers)") BY host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process AS rclone_cmd | join host [| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as destroy_time FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE (Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND match(Processes.process,"(?i)(delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage)")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND match(Processes.process,"(?i)delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup|backup)")) OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND match(Processes.process,"(?i)(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|safeboot)")) OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND match(Processes.process,"(?i)shadowcopy\s+delete")) BY host Processes.process Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process AS destroy_cmd process_name AS destroy_bin] | where destroy_time > rclone_time AND (destroy_time - rclone_time) < 86400 | eval minutes_to_impact = round((destroy_time - rclone_time)/60,1) | table host dest user rclone_cmd destroy_bin destroy_cmd minutes_to_impact | sort minutes_to_impact
ucs.kql:
let Window = 7d;
let Recovery = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Window)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage)")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup|backup)")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|safeboot)")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
    | project DestroyTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DestroyBin = FileName, DestroyCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Window)
| where (FileName =~ "rclone.exe" or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone")
     or (ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\brclone(\.exe)?\b" and FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe"))
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|userstorage|--config|\bcopy\b|\bsync\b|\bmoveto\b|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams)"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner Recovery on DeviceId
| where DestroyTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 24h)
| project RcloneTime = Timestamp, DestroyTime, DeviceName, AccountName,
          RcloneCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          DestroyBin, DestroyCmd,
          MinutesToImpact = datetime_diff('minute', DestroyTime, Timestamp)
| order by MinutesToImpact asc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 7d;
let Recovery = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where (TargetProcessName has "vssadmin.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage)")
         or (TargetProcessName has "wbadmin.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)delete\s+(catalog|systemstatebackup|backup)")
         or (TargetProcessName has "bcdedit.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|safeboot)")
         or (TargetProcessName has "wmic.exe" and TargetProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
    | project DestroyTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              DestroyBin = TargetProcessName, DestroyCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
| where (TargetProcessName has "rclone.exe" or ActingProcessFileOriginalName =~ "rclone")
     or (TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\brclone(\.exe)?\b" and TargetProcessName has_any ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe"))
| where TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|userstorage|--config|\bcopy\b|\bsync\b|\bmoveto\b|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams)"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner Recovery on $left.DvcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where DestroyTime between (TimeGenerated .. TimeGenerated + 24h)
| project RcloneTime = TimeGenerated, DestroyTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          RcloneCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
          DestroyBin, DestroyCmd,
          MinutesToImpact = datetime_diff('minute', DestroyTime, TimeGenerated)
| order by MinutesToImpact asc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\Rclone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*rclone* OR *RCLONE*)) @CommandLine:(*mega.nz* OR *mega.co.nz* OR *userstorage* OR *--config* OR *--transfers* OR *--multi-thread-streams*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/\brclone(\.exe)?\b/i
| CommandLine=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|userstorage|--config|\bcopy\b|\bsync\b|\bmoveto\b|--transfers|--multi-thread-streams)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join(query={#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wbadmin|bcdedit|wmic)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(delete\s+shadows|delete\s+catalog|delete\s+systemstatebackup|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|safeboot|shadowcopy\s+delete)/i) | rename(field=CommandLine, as=DestroyCmd) | rename(field=ImageFileName, as=DestroyBin)}, field=aid, include=[DestroyBin, DestroyCmd])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, DestroyBin, DestroyCmd], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Each leg alone is noisy (admins sometimes use Rclone, IT sometimes resizes VSS), but their conjunction on the same host within 24h is a textbook RansomHub kill-chain documented in CISA AA24-242A, Symantec, and Mandiant M-Trends 2025. The MEGA/userstorage tokens and Rclone's `--transfers`/`--multi-thread-streams` flags are the affiliate-default exfil profile shared with ALPHV/BlackCat lineage — bul
